scope: Memory-leak audit: listeners, timers and in-process caches for bot, dashboard and workers.

findings.problem: globalBuckets, perCommandBuckets and componentBuckets retained unique Discord/user-command keys for process lifetime with no TTL pruning or hard capacity bound.
findings.remediation: Hard-cap each map, prune expired windows before eviction, preserve per-window isolation, and regression-test high-cardinality plus expiry recovery.

contracts.boundedRateLimitMaps: all three interaction rate-limit maps are hard-capped and expired entries are pruned before active eviction
contracts.noUnboundedMaps: remaining global caches must have TTL, max size, lifecycle ownership, or documented bounded cardinality
contracts.timers: intervals must be unref'd or explicitly stopped on owned shutdown paths
contracts.regression: rate-limit semantics remain independent across global, per-command and component buckets
contracts.runtimeEvidence: the exact-SHA allocation/recovery series records RSS, heap, active resources, requests, handles and listeners; the longer full-stack soak remains Stage 51 scope

verification.interpretation: RSS slope 0.0338 MiB/sample; heap slope 0.0071 MiB/sample; active-resource and listener slopes zero across 12 explicit-GC allocation/recovery samples.
